metadata.detection_notes: Review business continuity plans, disaster recovery procedures, risk assessments, and mitigation strategies. Verify risk mitigation activities are identified and implemented for business disruption scenarios.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC9 Risk Mitigation
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Secure Asset Disposal
signals.description: The entity does not discontinue logical and physical protections over physical assets only after the ability to read or recover data and software from those assets has been diminished.
signals.applicability: Hardware disposal, media sanitization

metadata.detection_notes: Review asset disposal procedures, media sanitization practices, and certificate of destruction documentation. Verify that data is securely erased before decommissioning hardware.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC6 Logical and Physical Access Controls
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Technology General Controls
signals.description: The entity does not select and develop general control activities over technology to support the achievement of objectives.
signals.applicability: Applies to all entities when technology general controls (ITGC) are not designed or implemented, including controls over infrastructure, security management, change management, and operations.

metadata.detection_notes: Review ITGC documentation, change management procedures, access controls over infrastructure, backup and recovery controls, and technology operations controls. Look for absence of ITGCs, lack of change control, inadequate infrastructure security, or missing technology operations controls.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC5 Control Activities
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: Data Transmission Protection Missing
signals.description: The organization has not implemented adequate protection for data in transit. This signal indicates the absence of encryption or other security measures to protect data during transmission.
signals.applicability: Organizations pursuing SOC 2 certification, Service organizations transmitting sensitive data

metadata.detection_notes: Detection involves reviewing network configurations, checking for TLS/SSL implementation, and verifying encryption is used for sensitive data transmission.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC6 Logical and Physical Access Controls
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Information Transmission Security
signals.description: The entity does not restrict the transmission, movement, and removal of information to authorized internal and external users and processes and does not protect it during transmission, movement, or removal.
signals.applicability: Data transfer, encryption in transit, data movement

metadata.detection_notes: Review data transmission mechanisms, encryption protocols (TLS/SSL), data transfer policies, and controls over data movement. Test whether data is protected during transmission across networks.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC6 Logical and Physical Access Controls
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No User Registration and Authorization
signals.description: Prior to issuing system credentials and granting system access, the entity does not register and authorize new internal and external users.
signals.applicability: Identity and access management processes

metadata.detection_notes: Review user provisioning processes, access request workflows, and approval documentation. Verify that user registration and authorization procedures exist before credential issuance.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC6 Logical and Physical Access Controls
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: User Access Removal Process Missing
signals.description: The organization has not established a formal process for removing user access when no longer needed. This signal indicates the absence of procedures for timely revocation of access rights upon termination or role change.
signals.applicability: Organizations pursuing SOC 2 certification, Service organizations with user access management requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection involves reviewing access removal procedures, examining termination checklists, and verifying that access revocation is timely and complete.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC6 Logical and Physical Access Controls
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Vendor and Partner Risk Management
signals.canonical_name: No Vendor and Partner Risk Management
signals.description: The entity does not assess and manage risks associated with vendors and business partners.
signals.applicability: Third-party risk management, vendor assessments

metadata.detection_notes: Review vendor risk management program, third-party assessments, due diligence procedures, and ongoing vendor monitoring. Verify vendor contracts include security requirements and vendor performance is monitored.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC9 Risk Mitigation
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Vulnerability Detection and Monitoring
signals.description: The entity does not use detection and monitoring procedures to identify changes to configurations that result in the introduction of new vulnerabilities and susceptibilities to newly discovered vulnerabilities.
signals.applicability: Vulnerability scanning, configuration monitoring

metadata.detection_notes: Review vulnerability scanning processes, patch management procedures, configuration monitoring tools, and vulnerability assessment reports. Verify regular vulnerability scans and remediation tracking.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC7 System Operations
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Confidential Information Identification
signals.description: The entity does not identify and maintain confidential information to meet the entity's objectives related to confidentiality.
signals.applicability: Data classification, information inventory

metadata.detection_notes: Review data classification policies, information inventory, data labeling schemes, and confidentiality definitions. Check for absence of classification framework, unlabeled sensitive data, or unclear confidentiality criteria.

sources.title: AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Confidential Information Disposal
signals.description: The entity does not dispose of confidential information to meet the entity's objectives related to confidentiality.
signals.applicability: Secure data destruction, retention policies

metadata.detection_notes: Review data disposal policies, secure deletion procedures, media sanitization processes, and retention schedules. Check for absence of disposal procedures, insecure deletion methods, or retention policy violations.

sources.title: AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Input and Output Storage Controls
signals.canonical_name: No Input and Output Storage Controls
signals.description: The entity does not implement policies and procedures to store inputs, items in processing, and outputs completely, accurately, and timely in accordance with system specifications.
signals.applicability: Data storage, archival processes

metadata.detection_notes: Review data storage policies, archival procedures, retention controls, storage validation processes, and data integrity checks. Check for absence of storage controls, retention policies, or data integrity verification.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - Processing Integrity
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Input Completeness and Accuracy Controls
signals.canonical_name: No Input Completeness and Accuracy Controls
signals.description: The entity does not implement policies and procedures over system inputs, including controls over completeness and accuracy.
signals.applicability: Input validation, data quality controls

metadata.detection_notes: Review input validation logic, data quality checks, error handling for invalid inputs, and validation policies. Check for absence of input controls, validation rules, or completeness checks.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - Processing Integrity
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Output Completeness and Accuracy Controls
signals.canonical_name: No Output Completeness and Accuracy Controls
signals.description: The entity does not implement policies and procedures to make available or deliver output completely, accurately, and timely in accordance with specifications.
signals.applicability: Output validation, reporting accuracy

metadata.detection_notes: Review output validation controls, report generation procedures, data export processes, output reconciliation, and delivery mechanisms. Check for absence of output validation, completeness checks, or accuracy verification before delivery.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - Processing Integrity
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Processing Policies and Procedures
signals.description: The entity does not implement policies and procedures over system processing to result in products, services, and reporting to meet the entity's product or service specifications.
signals.applicability: Data processing controls, batch processing

metadata.detection_notes: Review data processing procedures, transformation logic, quality controls during processing, reconciliation processes, and error handling. Check for absence of processing controls, validation during processing, or quality assurance measures.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - Processing Integrity
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Processing Specifications
signals.description: The entity does not obtain or generate, use, and communicate quality information regarding the objectives related to processing, including definitions of data processed and product and service specifications.
signals.applicability: Data processing documentation, service specifications

metadata.detection_notes: Review data processing documentation, service level agreements, data dictionaries, processing specifications, and quality standards. Check for absence of documented processing objectives, data definitions, or quality criteria.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - Processing Integrity
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Access Denial Notification
signals.description: The entity does not inform data subjects if access to their personal information is denied and provides the reason for denial. This signal indicates that individuals are not adequately notified when their access requests are rejected, which undermines transparency and privacy rights.
signals.applicability: Applicable to data subject access request workflows, customer service procedures, self-service portals, and any system or process that may deny access to personal information.

metadata.detection_notes: Commonly detected through review of access request procedures, denial notification templates, customer service scripts, and workflow automation. May be identified by absence of denial notification mechanisms, missing reason documentation, or incomplete response procedures.

sources.title: AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Data Breach Notification
signals.description: The entity does not notify affected data subjects, regulators, and others when a data breach has occurred in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. This signal indicates that critical breach notification obligations may not be met, potentially violating legal requirements and undermining trust.
signals.applicability: Applicable to breach response procedures, notification workflows, regulatory compliance processes, incident management systems, and communication protocols for data breaches.

metadata.detection_notes: Commonly detected through review of breach notification procedures, incident response plans, regulatory compliance documentation, and notification tracking systems. May be identified by absence of notification workflows, missing breach communication plans, or lack of regulatory reporting procedures.

sources.title: AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Communication of Choices
signals.description: The entity does not communicate choices available regarding the collection, use, retention, disclosure, and disposal of personal information to data subjects.
signals.applicability: Consent mechanisms, preference centers

metadata.detection_notes: Verify presence and clarity of mechanisms for data subjects to understand and exercise choices regarding their personal information

sources.title: AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Collection Limitation
signals.description: The entity does not limit the collection of personal information to that which is necessary to meet its objectives.
signals.applicability: Data minimization, collection practices

metadata.detection_notes: Review data collection forms, APIs, and processes to ensure only necessary information is collected for stated purposes

sources.title: AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Privacy Compliance Monitoring
signals.description: The entity does not implement a process for receiving, addressing, resolving, and communicating the resolution of inquiries, complaints, and disputes from data subjects. This signal indicates that the organization lacks mechanisms to handle privacy concerns from individuals, undermining accountability and data subject rights.
signals.applicability: Applicable to privacy complaint handling systems, customer service operations, data subject inquiry workflows, privacy team processes, and complaint tracking systems.

metadata.detection_notes: Commonly detected through review of complaint handling procedures, customer service workflows, privacy inquiry tracking systems, and resolution documentation. May be identified by absence of complaint channels, missing resolution processes, or lack of communication protocols.

sources.title: AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Privacy Compliance Review
signals.description: The entity does not periodically monitor compliance with its privacy policies and procedures. This signal indicates that the organization lacks ongoing oversight of privacy practices, potentially allowing policy violations and privacy risks to go undetected.
signals.applicability: Applicable to privacy compliance programs, audit and review processes, privacy monitoring systems, internal controls, and privacy governance frameworks.

metadata.detection_notes: Commonly detected through review of privacy audit schedules, compliance monitoring procedures, privacy assessment documentation, and oversight mechanisms. May be identified by absence of periodic reviews, missing monitoring controls, or lack of compliance reporting.

sources.title: AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Consent for New Uses
signals.description: The entity does not obtain consent for uses of personal information beyond those stated in the privacy notice when such consent is required.
signals.applicability: Consent collection, purpose limitation

metadata.detection_notes: Review consent collection processes for secondary uses, new purposes, and changes to original privacy notice disclosures

sources.title: AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Data Accuracy and Completeness
signals.description: The entity does not collect and maintain accurate, up-to-date, complete, and relevant personal information for the purposes identified in the privacy notice. This signal indicates that data quality controls are insufficient, potentially leading to incorrect decisions, poor customer experiences, and privacy violations.
signals.applicability: Applicable to data collection processes, data maintenance procedures, data validation systems, customer data management, and any system that stores or processes personal information.

metadata.detection_notes: Commonly detected through review of data validation rules, data quality procedures, update mechanisms, and data governance policies. May be identified by absence of validation controls, missing update workflows, or lack of data quality monitoring.

sources.title: AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Data Relevance
signals.description: The entity does not verify that personal information is relevant for the purposes for which it is collected and used. This signal indicates that the organization may be collecting excessive or unnecessary data, violating data minimization principles and increasing privacy risks.
signals.applicability: Applicable to data collection forms, privacy impact assessments, data mapping exercises, system design reviews, and data governance processes.

metadata.detection_notes: Commonly detected through review of data collection practices, privacy impact assessments, data inventory documentation, and purpose specification analysis. May be identified by excessive data fields, missing purpose justifications, or lack of data minimization reviews.

sources.title: AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Disclosure Limitation
signals.description: The entity does not disclose personal information to third parties only for the purposes identified in the privacy notice and with the implicit or explicit consent of the data subject. This signal indicates that personal data may be shared beyond stated purposes or without proper consent mechanisms, violating privacy commitments and data protection principles.
signals.applicability: Applicable to any system, service, or process that shares personal information with third parties, including API integrations, data partnerships, marketing platforms, service providers, and data sharing agreements.

metadata.detection_notes: Commonly detected through analysis of third-party integrations, data sharing agreements, API configurations, privacy policies, and consent management systems. May be identified by overly broad data sharing, missing consent mechanisms, or discrepancies between privacy notices and actual practices.

sources.title: AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Disclosure Records
signals.description: The entity does not create and retain a complete, accurate, and timely record of detected or reported unauthorized disclosures of personal information. This signal indicates that privacy incidents involving data disclosure are not properly documented, hindering incident response and accountability.
signals.applicability: Applicable to privacy incident management, breach response procedures, disclosure tracking systems, security monitoring, and incident documentation processes.

metadata.detection_notes: Commonly detected through review of incident management systems, privacy breach logs, security monitoring configurations, and incident response procedures. May be identified by absence of disclosure tracking, missing incident documentation, or incomplete breach records.

sources.title: AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Dispute Resolution
signals.description: The entity does not have procedures for resolving disputes related to privacy. This signal indicates that the organization lacks formal mechanisms to address disagreements or conflicts with data subjects regarding privacy practices, potentially leading to escalated conflicts and regulatory issues.
signals.applicability: Applicable to privacy dispute resolution processes, escalation procedures, privacy team operations, legal and compliance functions, and alternative dispute resolution mechanisms.

metadata.detection_notes: Commonly detected through review of dispute resolution procedures, escalation protocols, privacy policy commitments, and complaint handling documentation. May be identified by absence of formal dispute processes, missing escalation paths, or lack of alternative resolution mechanisms.

sources.title: AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Confirmation of Identity
signals.description: The entity does not authenticate data subjects' identities before providing them with access to their personal information. This signal indicates that the organization lacks proper verification procedures to ensure that personal data is only disclosed to the legitimate data subject, potentially exposing sensitive information to unauthorized parties.
signals.applicability: Applicable to any system or process that handles data subject access requests, including self-service portals, customer service workflows, data export functionality, and identity verification systems.

metadata.detection_notes: Commonly detected through review of access request procedures, identity verification workflows, authentication mechanisms for data access, and customer service protocols. May be identified by absence of verification steps, weak authentication requirements, or missing identity proofing procedures.

sources.title: AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Privacy Incident Reporting
signals.description: The entity does not document and report privacy incidents to appropriate parties. This signal indicates that privacy violations and incidents are not properly tracked, escalated, or communicated to stakeholders, potentially hiding systemic issues and preventing effective response.
signals.applicability: Applicable to privacy incident management, incident reporting systems, privacy team operations, management communication, and regulatory reporting processes.

metadata.detection_notes: Commonly detected through review of incident management procedures, reporting workflows, escalation protocols, and privacy documentation. May be identified by absence of incident tracking, missing reporting mechanisms, or lack of management communication.

sources.title: AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Privacy Notice
signals.description: The entity does not provide notice to data subjects about its privacy practices to meet the entity's objectives related to privacy.
signals.applicability: Privacy policies, data collection notices

metadata.detection_notes: Review privacy notice availability, accessibility, and completeness for data subjects at or before the point of data collection

sources.title: AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Retention Policies
signals.description: The entity does not retain personal information for only as long as necessary to fulfill the stated purposes or as required by law or regulations.
signals.applicability: Data retention schedules, storage limitation

metadata.detection_notes: Review data retention policies, automated deletion processes, and storage duration practices across data categories

sources.title: AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Secure PII Disposal
signals.description: The entity does not securely dispose of personal information to meet the entity's objectives related to privacy.
signals.applicability: Secure deletion, PII destruction

metadata.detection_notes: Review disposal methods for electronic and physical media containing personal information, including deletion verification and media destruction procedures

sources.title: AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Explicit Consent for Sensitive Data
signals.canonical_name: No Explicit Consent for Sensitive Data
signals.description: The entity does not obtain explicit consent for collection of sensitive personal information.
signals.applicability: Sensitive data categories, explicit consent

metadata.detection_notes: Review consent mechanisms for sensitive information categories including health data, financial data, biometric data, and protected characteristics

sources.title: AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Data Subject Access
signals.description: The entity does not provide data subjects with access to their personal information for review and update. This signal indicates that individuals lack the ability to view, verify, or modify their own personal data held by the organization, which is a fundamental privacy requirement.
signals.applicability: Applicable to any system, application, or service that processes personal information and should provide data subjects with access rights. Includes customer portals, self-service platforms, data access request workflows, and privacy management systems.

metadata.detection_notes: Commonly detected through review of privacy policies, self-service portal capabilities, data subject request procedures, and system functionality. May be identified by absence of access request mechanisms, lack of user portals, or missing processes for responding to access requests.

sources.title: AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Third-Party Disclosure Authorization
signals.description: The entity does not create and retain a record of authorized disclosures of personal information. This signal indicates that the organization lacks documentation of legitimate data sharing activities, making it difficult to demonstrate compliance with privacy commitments and track data flows.
signals.applicability: Applicable to data sharing operations, third-party integrations, consent management systems, data processing agreements, and disclosure tracking mechanisms.

metadata.detection_notes: Commonly detected through review of disclosure logs, consent records, data sharing agreements, audit trails, and privacy documentation. May be identified by absence of disclosure tracking, missing authorization documentation, or incomplete record-keeping practices.

sources.title: AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Limitation on Use
signals.description: The entity does not limit the use of personal information to the purposes identified in the privacy notice and for which the data subject has provided implicit or explicit consent.
signals.applicability: Purpose limitation, secondary use controls

metadata.detection_notes: Monitor data usage patterns and compare against stated purposes in privacy notices and consent records

sources.title: AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
